verdict.rationale: LegalZoom documents access to a library of 150+ customizable legal documents (for 1 year with the LLC package) and includes an operating agreement, which directly matches a founder using templates for routine documents. A lawyer's community comment that operating agreements aren't a commodity is general caution, not a concrete failure of the library. Missing for 10: named coverage of NDAs and policies, evidence the templates are attorney-vetted, clarity on access beyond the 1-year bundled term, and independent hands-on corroboration of template quality.
